2901.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2901.description:
Narrow arrow slits pierce the parapet here, set at the height of a
kneeling archer and splayed wide on the inner face, tight as a finger on
the outer. The flagstones are worn into shallow troughs by generations
of boots, and rainwater lies in them after every shower. The walk goes
on east along the crenels and back west toward the stairhead above the
gate.

2902.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies A Turn On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2902.description:
A banner of the city hangs from an iron pole socketed in the parapet,
its colours bleached by the sun and its hem frayed to ribbons by the
wind. The pole creaks in its bracket with every gust. Out past the
crenels the plains roll away in squares of field and fallow, cut by the
pale thread of the Trade Road. The wall bends round a corner a little
way east, and west lies the way back to the gate.

2903.name: A Turn On The City Wall

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2903.description:
The wall turns here at a hard angle, the parapet swelling into a rounded
buttress that juts out over the foot of the wall. A stone bench is built
into the inner side, its seat polished by sitters, and the gusts drop
away in the lee of the corner. The walk leads west along the battlements
and south along the next long run of wall. Far across the plains the
hills lie low and blue.

2904.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies A Turn On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2904.description:
A beacon stack stands on a round iron grate in the middle of the walk, a
heap of tar-blackened logs under a tarred canvas hood, waiting for the
night it must be lit. Soot streaks the stone around it up to the height
of the crenels. Below the inner side the long roof of a timber warehouse
shows, with a cart track running past it toward the market. The wall
runs north toward the corner and south along the parapet.

2905.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2905.description:
Someone has cut a row of initials and tally marks into the soft stone of
a merlon at shoulder height, the oldest worn round and shallow, the
newest still sharp and white. A rain barrel stands at the foot of the
parapet, its lid weighted with a flat stone. The wind slides along the
wall here carrying the smell of cut grass from the fields beyond.
Battlements stretch away both north and south.

2906.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2906.description:
The paving beneath your boots turns from pale grey to a darker, newer
flagging where the walk was relaid, the join marked by a ridge of mortar
like a scar. Iron spikes crown the outer parapet to discourage climbers,
rust bleeding down the stone below each one. Over the rooftops of the
inner side the Temple dome shows as a green copper hemisphere catching
the light. North the walk runs back along the battlements, and south it
reaches a stairhead tower.

2907.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2907.description:
A catapult emplacement fills a widened bay of the wall here, a squat
stone platform ringed with low sandbags. The throwing engine rests
cocked beneath a tarpaulin, its arm bound down with a rope as thick as a
wrist, and pale scars from its wheels are cut deep into the flags. A
pyramid of round stone shot waits beside it. The walk goes on north and
south past the platform.

2908.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2908.description:
A narrow shrine niche is cut into the inner parapet, hardly deeper than
a hand, where a small figure of a woman holding a lamp is carved from
the stone itself. Stubs of candles and a few withered flowers lie on the
sill, stirred by the wind. Lichen has crept up from the sill around the
figure like a green shawl. The wall-walk runs on to the north and to the
south.

extra_descs.shrine niche figure lamp:
The little carved woman holds a stone lamp in both hands, her face
rubbed featureless by the touch of passing fingers. Someone has pushed a
sprig of dried lavender into the crack beside her.

2909.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2909.description:
A stretch of the outer parapet the length of a cart is built of newer,
yellower stone, its courses neat against the weathered grey on either
side. A mason's mark, a hammer and a square, is cut in the corner block
of the mended breach. Beyond it the ground slopes away to a ditch, its
bank trampled and scorched by some old assault. You can follow the wall
north or south from here.

extra_descs.mended breach newer stone mason mark:
The yellow stone is cleanly cut and closely jointed, far better work
than the old wall around it. The mason's hammer-and-square mark is cut
deep, as if the builder wished to be remembered for filling the gap.

2910.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2910.description:
A square watchtower rises from the wall here and the walk passes through
its open archway, the vault above streaked with old rain and soot. A
wooden bench runs along one wall of the passage, and an arrow loop looks
out over the fields. The door of the tower's upper room is barred and
shut fast. Beyond the arch the battlements continue north and south.

2911.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2911.description:
A wooden pigeon loft on stilts stands against the inner parapet, its
slatted face stuffed with straw and its perches white with droppings.
The little doors are hooked open, and the cote is silent and empty. A
wicker message basket hangs from a nail beside the door. The walk heads
off north along the crenels, and south as well.

2912.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2912.description:
From the inner parapet the whole market lies below, a crowded sprawl of
striped awnings, stalls and carts, with the hum of bargaining drifting
up on the wind. The smell of baking bread and frying onions rises with
it. Out beyond the crenels the plains are quiet by comparison. The wall
carries on north and south.

2913.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2913.description:
The Trade Road lies below the outer wall here, a pale dusty ribbon
between ditches, with a waymark stone at the verge and the ruts of
wagons pressed deep in the dirt. Dust hangs over it in dry weather. The
crenels frame a long view of the road running out across the plains
toward the far hills. Walkers on the wall can go north or south from
this spot.

2914.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2914.description:
Carved stone spouts jut from the outer parapet at intervals, each shaped
into a snarling hound with its mouth gaping to throw rain clear of the
wall. Their muzzles are stained green and streaked white with lime. The
coping between them is cracked and patched with lead. The wall continues
north toward the corner and south along the parapet.

2915.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2915.description:
A timber crane stands on the inner edge of the walk, a stout post and a
swinging jib with a pulley and a coil of tarred rope, used to haul
stores up from the street. Its arm is swung in and lashed to the post
against the wind. The flags beneath are scuffed and stained with oil.
The parapet leads north and also south from the crane.

2916.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2916.description:
A little sentry box with a pitched shingle roof stands against the outer
parapet, open on the side that faces the walk, with a narrow slot for a
lantern cut in the back plank. Initials and crude drawings of ships
cover the inside boards. The wind whistles through the gaps between the
planks. Beyond the box the wall goes on north and south.

2917.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2917.description:
A small stone garderobe juts from the outer face of the wall here, its
low door hanging ajar on a leather hinge, and a sour smell clings about
it despite the breeze. A drain channel runs down through the wall below.
Nearby the coping is dark with damp. The battlements run north and south
of this corner of the wall.

2918.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2918.description:
Orange and grey lichen blooms across the parapet in rings, and tufts of
stonecrop and thrift grow from the cracks in the coping. An iron lantern
hangs from a post at the inner edge, its horn panes yellowed and
cracked. The air up here is quiet and the wind comes in long even
breaths. The walk lies open north and south.

2919.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2919.description:
An alarm bell hangs in a timber frame beside the walk, a bronze bell as
big as a barrel with a worn rope dangling from its clapper. Green stains
streak its shoulder, and its note sounds faintly when the wind catches
it. A cleared space around the frame keeps the way free. The wall-walk
passes on north and south.

extra_descs.alarm bell frame:
The bronze is thick and pitted, and a band of letters round its lip is
too corroded to read. The frame is braced with iron straps, and its rope
has been spliced many times.

2920.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn On The City Wall.

2920.description:
A long scorched smear blackens the outer parapet where fire arrows once
struck, the stone cracked and flaking beneath the soot. Fresh mortar
fills a few of the worst gaps. Inward the crowded roofs fall away into a
narrow lane of tiled gables. The walk runs north back along the
battlements and south to a turn in the wall.

2921.name: A Turn On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2921.description:
A round turret caps the corner, its conical slate roof held up on stone
pillars so that the wind sweeps freely through. A stone seat curves
round the inside of the turret, and the mounting for a signal horn is
bolted to a pillar. The long wall runs away on both sides, north back
toward the gate and west along the next stretch. Beyond the crenels the
plains stretch off to the hills in a haze.

2922.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies A Turn On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2922.description:
A windmill stands on a low rise out on the plains, its sails turning
slowly with a creak that carries faintly even this high. Fields of
barley and beans surround it in neat strips. The parapet underfoot is
smooth and dry, and a crack in the coping holds a line of tufted grass.
The walk runs east to the corner turret and west along the battlements.

2923.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2923.description:
Over the inner parapet a slender bell tower topped with a green copper
cap rises above the nearest roofs, and its notes come across the
rooftops on the wind. The battlements here are cut by a row of deep
crenels with stone seats built into the merlons. The walk leads east
toward the corner and west toward the stair tower.

2924.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2924.description:
A lone oak stands out on the plains beyond a hedgerow, its crown bent by
the prevailing wind, with a low cairn of stones at its foot. The outer
parapet is sound here and the crenels are wide enough to lean out. The
flagstones are lightly dusted with chalky grit blown from the road. You
can go east back to the stair tower, or west along the battlements.

2925.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn On The City Wall.

2925.description:
A machicolation juts out from the outer face, and the slots in the floor
of the little projection show the base of the wall far below and the
ditch at its foot. A cold draught rises through the slots. Stone corbels
carry the projection, each carved with a blunt face. The walk goes east
toward the stair tower and west to a turn in the wall.

2926.name: A Turn On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

2926.description:
A tall flagstaff stands planted in the corner of the wall, its halyard
drumming against the pole and the great banner of Garathorm streaming
out stiff as a board in the wind. The parapet curves round the corner in
a thick rounded bastion. The walk leads north along the next stretch of
wall and east back along the battlements.

2927.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn On The City Wall.

2927.description:
The inner parapet is lower than the outer here, barely waist high, its
coping rounded smooth by elbows. Below it the yards and back lanes of
the city look small and tidy, with washing lines strung between
chimneys. The outer face shows blank grey stone and tiny arrow slits.
The wall-walk goes north along the battlements and south to the corner
bastion.

2928.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2928.description:
Moss and small ferns sprout from the joints of the coping, and long
green stains show where rainwater runs down the outer face. A puddle
fills a dip in the flagstones, rippling in the gusts. The air smells of
damp stone and distant hay. The wall-walk stretches away to the north
and the south.

2929.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2929.description:
A black iron cauldron big enough to bathe a child hangs from a tripod
beside the outer parapet, a bed of ash beneath it, for heating oil to
pour on besiegers. Soot has darkened the crenel above it in a long
streak. A trough of dry kindling stands against the wall. Past the
tripod the battlements go on north and south.

2930.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2930.description:
A timber hoarding has been built out over the outer face on stout
corbels, a roofed gallery of planks with gaps in the floor and shutters
on its front. The wood is silvered by weather and smells of pitch.
Through the cracks you can see the foot of the wall far below. The walk
heads north and south beneath the gallery.

2931.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2931.description:
A bronze sundial is set into the inner parapet, its gnomon green with
age and its numerals worn nearly smooth by many palms. When the sun is
out its shadow slides across the dial in a thin dark line. The stone
around it has been scrubbed pale. From the dial the walk runs north and
also south.

extra_descs.sundial gnomon dial:
The dial is cast in bronze and bolted into the coping, its hour lines
cut deep. The gnomon leans a little out of true, as though someone once
used it as a handhold.

2932.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2932.description:
Rows of apple trees stand in an orchard beyond the ditch below the outer
wall, their branches propped with forked poles. A low stone fence
encloses them, and a path leads off through the grass toward the hills.
The crenels here are fitted with worn stone sills. The battlements lead
on to the north and to the south.

2933.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2933.description:
A low stone hut squats against the inner parapet, its chimney leaking a
thin thread of smoke and its shutters closed against the wind. A
woodpile stacked beneath the eaves is capped with turf. The door is
shut, and an iron boot-scraper stands beside it. The walk passes the hut
going north or south.

2934.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2934.description:
A weathered plaque is set into the inner parapet, its chiselled letters
recording the raising of this stretch of the wall, the lines filled with
moss and the last words worn away. A shallow gutter has been cut beneath
it to carry the rain clear. The wall-walk runs on past the plaque, north
and south alike.

extra_descs.plaque letters inscription:
The plaque says that this length of the wall was raised by the city's
masons and its labouring people, and the date is cut in old numerals.
The final line has crumbled into smooth stone.

2935.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2935.description:
Smoke and the ring of hammers rise from a smithy's yard below the inner
side, and the warm smell of charcoal and hot iron reaches the walk.
Sparks from the forge chimney sometimes swirl up over the parapet. Out
beyond the outer face the plains are green and still. Walkers may go
north or south along the top of the wall.

2936.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2936.description:
Here the wall stands at its tallest, where the ground outside dips into
a hollow, and the outer face drops sheer to a dry ditch far below. The
arrow slits are fitted with stout iron bars. The wind pulls hardest at
your cloak in this stretch. The walk leads off both north and south.

2937.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2937.description:
One merlon of the outer parapet has been split by lightning, the broken
halves bound together with iron straps, and the stone around the crack
is glassy and black. A fused patch in the flagging shows where the bolt
struck. Rain gathers there and drains slowly through the crack. North
and south the walk continues.

2938.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2938.description:
In the inner wall an arched doorway has been bricked up, its outline
picked out in paler mortar, so that it leads nowhere but into solid
wall. Someone has chalked a tally of days on the infill. Beside it a
stone water trough stands empty, cracked along its base. The battlements
go on north and south from here.

2939.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2939.description:
A pair of crenels are fitted with hinged wooden shutters painted with
the city's sign, their leather hinges creaking whenever the wind pushes
against them. Through the gaps you can see the plains stretching away to
the dim line of the hills. The air smells of rain far off. You may
follow the wall north or south.

2940.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2940.description:
Ahead the roof of the tower over the gate rises above the walk, and the
stone underfoot is stained dark with the ash of its brazier. A bracket
of black iron holds a lantern at head height. The parapet on either side
is thick and stout, built to guard the approach. The walk runs north to
the tower and south along the wall.

2941.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2941.description:
Beyond the outer parapet terraced rows of vines climb a gentle slope
toward a small stone house, the leaves turning rust and gold along their
trellises. The scent of crushed grapes sometimes rides up on the wind.
The coping is smooth, with a groove where leaning arms have rested.
North of the platform the walk goes on, and south it returns to the
tower.

2942.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2942.description:
A lead-lined channel runs along the inner foot of the parapet, carrying
rainwater to a covered cistern whose stone lid has an iron ring. The
lead is dented and patched with pewter. Over the roofs inward the grey
sprawl of streets climbs to a cluster of tall slate-roofed spires. The
wall runs north toward a corner and south toward the gate tower.

2943.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies A Turn On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2943.description:
Rust streaks the parapet below the iron cramps that hold the coping
together, and the stone is stained a dull orange. Wind hums through an
arrow loop that has lost its shutter. The inner side overlooks a long
narrow court of drying racks and sheds. The walk goes north to the
corner and south along the wall.

2944.name: A Turn On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

2944.description:
A heavy drum of masonry forms the corner here, the walk curving around
it and the parapet scratched with old sling-bullet scars. From the bend
the wall can be seen running away in two long straight arms, one of them
pale and narrowing into the haze. A stone spout drains the rain from the
corner. The walk leads east along the battlements and south along the
other arm.

2945.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn On The City Wall.

2945.description:
A row of iron hooks is set along the inner parapet for hanging festival
banners, and they stand bare now, rusty and bent. Below the inner edge
the steep roof of a great hall shows, its ridge capped with crow-stepped
gables. The air is thin and cold at this height. The walk leads east
toward the stair tower and west to the corner.

2946.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

2946.description:
Scratched into one of the flagstones is the grid of a game of nine men's
morris, its lines worn pale by idle hours of play. The wind rushes up
the outer face and over the coping in a steady sigh. Ahead you can make
out the slate roof of a stairhead, with a thread of smoke curling from
its brazier. The walk leads east to the stairhead and west along the
battlements.

203070.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

down.description: To the down lies The Gate Of The Inner City.

203070.description:
Here the wall-walk swells into a small paved landing over the inner
gate, where a squat stairhead roofed in grey slate shelters the top of
the stair down to The Gate Of The Inner City. An iron brazier on a
tripod stands by the stairhead door, its ashes stirring in the wind, and
a rack of ash-shafted spears leans against the parapet. The battlements
run on east and west from the landing, and beyond the inner edge the
roofs of the city lie spread in a patchwork of tile and smoke.

203071.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

down.description: To the down lies The Gate To The Inner City.

203071.description:
A stout tower stands over the gate here, its iron-banded oak door
opening on the head of a stair that winds down to The Gate To The Inner
City. A brazier burns in a blackened basket beside the door, and a water
butt and a stack of kindling sit under a lean-to roof. Inward, the
footbridge between the gate towers spans the heavy gate like a stitched
seam. From the tower the walk leads north and south along the
crenellated wall.

203072.name: On The City Wall

east.description: To the east lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies On The City Wall.

down.description: To the down lies The Gate Of The Inner City.

203072.description:
A low stair tower caps the walk here, its roof of mossy green slate
sloping over a door that opens on the top of the stair down to The Gate
Of The Inner City. Orders for the wall are pinned on a weathered board
by the doorpost, the ink faded to brown. A hooded cresset hangs from a
bracket, black with old pitch. The wall-walk goes on east and west.

203073.name: On The City Wall

north.description: To the north lies On The City Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On The City Wall.

down.description: To the down lies Inside the West Gate of Garathorm.

203073.description:
A broad watch platform ringed by a thick crenelled parapet stands over
the gate, with a stair winding down from its flagged floor to the gate
hall below. Above the stairhead a shadowed ledge under the tower's
overhang makes a snug post for a sentry, with a stone stool and a view
along the road. A brazier glows in an iron stand, and the wind snaps at
a banner on the tower. The walk leads north and south from the platform.
